name: Switch Redemption Leg Execution 3
definition: Execution of the redemption part, in a switch between investment funds or investment fund classes.

LegIdentification.name: Leg Identification
LegIdentification.definition: Unique technical identifier for an instance of a leg within a switch.

LegExecutionIdentification.name: Leg Execution Identification
LegExecutionIdentification.definition: Unique identifier for an instance of a leg execution within a switch confirmation.

FinancialInstrumentDetails.name: Financial Instrument Details
FinancialInstrumentDetails.definition: Investment fund class to which an investment fund order execution is related.

UnitsNumber.name: Units Number
UnitsNumber.definition: Number of investment funds units redeemed.

InvestmentAccountDetails.name: Investment Account Details
InvestmentAccountDetails.definition: Account between an investor(s) and a fund manager or a fund. The account can contain holdings in any investment fund or investment fund class managed (or distributed) by the fund manager, within the same fund family.

HoldingsRedemptionRate.name: Holdings Redemption Rate
HoldingsRedemptionRate.definition: Portion of the investor's holdings, in a specific investment fund/ fund class, that is redeemed.

NetAmount.name: Net Amount
NetAmount.definition: Amount of money paid to the investor as a result of the redemption after deduction of charges, commissions and taxes.|[(Quantity * Price) - (Charges + Commissions +Taxes)].

GrossAmount.name: Gross Amount
GrossAmount.definition: Amount of money resulting from the redemption before deduction of charges, commissions and taxes.|[Quantity * Price].

TradeDateTime.name: Trade Date Time
TradeDateTime.definition: Date and time at which a price is applied, according to the terms stated in the prospectus.

PriceDetails.name: Price Details
PriceDetails.definition: Price at which the order was executed.

CumDividendIndicator.name: Cum Dividend Indicator
CumDividendIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the dividend is included, ie, cum-dividend, in the executed price. When the dividend is not included, the price will be ex-dividend.

InterimProfitAmount.name: Interim Profit Amount
InterimProfitAmount.definition: Part of the price deemed as accrued income or profit rather than capital. The interim profit amount is used for tax purposes.

IncomePreference.name: Income Preference
IncomePreference.definition: Dividend option chosen by the account owner based on the options offered in the prospectus.

Group1Or2Units.name: Group 1 Or 2 Units
Group1Or2Units.definition: Tax group to which the purchased investment fund units belong. The investor indicates to the intermediary operating pooled nominees, which type of unit is to be sold.

RequestedSettlementCurrency.name: Requested Settlement Currency
RequestedSettlementCurrency.definition: Currency requested for settlement of cash proceeds.

RequestedNAVCurrency.name: Requested NAV Currency
RequestedNAVCurrency.definition: Currency to be used for pricing the fund. This currency must be among the set of currencies in which the price may be expressed, as stated in the prospectus.

ChargeGeneralDetails.name: Charge General Details
ChargeGeneralDetails.definition: Amount of money associated with a service.

CommissionGeneralDetails.name: Commission General Details
CommissionGeneralDetails.definition: Commission for the execution of an investment fund order.

TaxGeneralDetails.name: Tax General Details
TaxGeneralDetails.definition: Tax applicable to execution of an investment fund order.

SettlementAndCustodyDetails.name: Settlement And Custody Details
SettlementAndCustodyDetails.definition: Parameters used to execute the settlement of an investment fund order.

PhysicalDeliveryIndicator.name: Physical Delivery Indicator
PhysicalDeliveryIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the financial instrument is to be physically delivered.

PhysicalDeliveryDetails.name: Physical Delivery Details
PhysicalDeliveryDetails.definition: Information related to physical delivery of the securities.

NonStandardSettlementInformation.name: Non Standard Settlement Information
NonStandardSettlementInformation.definition: Additional specific settlement information for non-regulated traded funds.

Equalisation.name: Equalisation
Equalisation.definition: Part of an investor's subscription amount that is held by the fund in order to pay incentive / performance fees at the end of the fiscal year.

PhysicalDeliveryDetailsRule.definition: If PhysicalDeliveryIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then PhysicalDeliveryDetails is not allowed. If PhysicalDeliveryIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then PhysicalDeliveryDetails must be present.
